headline: Anthropic reports three working electronic prototypes designed with Claude Fable 5.2
summary: Anthropic’s Nov. 9, 2026 report says Claude Fable 5.2 designed a speakerphone, voice-assistant hub and handheld virtual pet with Diode Computers. The model reportedly produced schematics, PCB layouts, enclosures, firmware and parts lists; Diode engineers assembled the boards under its direction, and all three prototypes reportedly worked without circuit changes. Anthropic also reports 69% on its partner’s internal PCB Gym versus 25% for Fable 5, and 83.5% on BenchCAD 2.1. These are provider-reported results. The prototypes have not undergone electrical validation, antenna tuning, thermal testing or certification, and no independent build was performed in this review.
